question: Describe a time you had to work with a difficult stakeholder.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates interpersonal skills and professional maturity.
exampleAnswer: A senior stakeholder frequently changed requirements mid-sprint. Situation: this was affecting team morale and delivery. I scheduled a 1:1 to understand their underlying concerns. I learned they were under pressure from their leadership. I proposed a change-request process with clear impact assessment. Result: requirement changes reduced by 60%, and the stakeholder appreciated the structured approach.
evaluationCriteria: Empathy, professional communication, structured resolution, outcome
followUpQuestions: How do you build trust with difficult stakeholders?
What if the stakeholder refuses to engage?
How do you set boundaries professionally?
